# Rifera — First Take

> 7,620 pixel cursor NFTs on BNB Chain. First mint per wallet FREE (gas only).
> Agents and bots welcome. All 7,620 takes open. No whitelist. No reservation.

## Site

- https://rifera.xyz/
- Mint spec (machine-readable): https://rifera.xyz/mint.json
- Agent instructions: https://rifera.xyz/agents.txt

## Mint

- Chain: BNB Chain, chainId 56
- Contract: 0x0Cd348360109dd7f966B94a37Ff9BB0542b07Ec3
- Function: mint(uint256 takeId) payable
- One take per call. Pick any unminted takeId, 1-7620.
- Price: first mint per wallet 0 BNB (gas only). Extra mints 0.002 BNB each.
- Requirement: the minting wallet must hold a Binance Agent ID.
  Agent ID contract: 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F (balanceOf >= 1).
- Rule: post first on X, then mint. Execute from your own wallet only.

Mint prompt (copy, fill in your wallet and take):

```
Mint Rifera First Take 0004 now.
Contract 0x0Cd348360109dd7f966B94a37Ff9BB0542b07Ec3, BNB Chain 56, mint(uint256 takeId) payable.
Wallet: [your wallet], holds Binance Agent ID. Execute from my wallet only.
Value: 0.002 BNB = 2000000000000000 wei + gas, 0 if first mint. Reply tx link only.
```

## Upgrade

- Same contract: 0x0Cd348360109dd7f966B94a37Ff9BB0542b07Ec3
- Function: upgrade(uint256 tokenId) payable
- One level per call, Level 1-5. 0.002 BNB per call.
- Only the take owner can upgrade it.

Upgrade prompt:

```
Upgrade Take 0001 to Level 5 now.
Contract 0x0Cd348360109dd7f966B94a37Ff9BB0542b07Ec3, BNB Chain 56, upgrade(uint256 tokenId) payable.
Wallet: [your wallet], owns Take 0001. Execute from my wallet only.
Value: 0.002 BNB = 2000000000000000 wei + gas per call, repeat until Level 5. Reply tx link only.
```

## Claim $CURSOR

- Claim contract: 0xcbd1010895D155563f693855D62614652fdf96eC
- Token: 0x5115EaE6a625b3438CE9aE75bb651f0c00A7d17f ($CURSOR, 10,000,000,000 supply)
- Function: claim(uint256 tokenId) payable
- Fee: 0.00021 BNB per take + gas. Once per take. Current holder only.
- Claim opens right after mint. No snapshot.
- Pool by level: Lv1 5%, Lv2 10%, Lv3 20%, Lv4 30%, Lv5 35% of the 5,000,000,000 claim pool.
- Trading: Tuesday 10 November 2026, 00:00 UTC, PancakeSwap.

Claim prompt:

```
Claim $CURSOR for Take 0001 now. Level 5 · 35% pool.
Contract 0xcbd1010895D155563f693855D62614652fdf96eC, BNB Chain 56, claim(uint256 tokenId) payable.
Wallet: [your wallet], owns Take 0001, not claimed yet. Execute from my wallet only.
Value: 0.00021 BNB = 210000000000000 wei + gas. Reply tx link + amount only.
```
